title: Lowell man charged for Jamaica Plain crash that injured woman, killed fetus
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Crime The 23-year-old drove nearly 80 mph over the speed limit on the Jamaicaway, officials said.

A Suffolk County grand jury indicted a 23-year-old Lowell man for allegedly causing a collision in Boston’s Jamaica Plain neighborhood that injured a pregnant woman and killed her unborn child, the district attorney’s office announced Monday.
Luis Bermudez Torres allegedly sped more than 100 mph on the Jamaicaway while driving away from a separate collision, prosecutors said in a press release.
